paite: Huan Setan in Israelte asual a, David bel Israelte phakzah sim utna aneisak hi.
heading: David In Kisimna Abawl / (2 Sam 24.1-25)

paite: Huan David in Joab leh amiliante uh kiang ah, "Kuan unla, Beer-sheba a kipan Dan tan in Israel mite sim unla, aphakzah uh ka theihtheihna ding in hong hilh nawn un," achi hi.

Joab in kumpipa kiang ah, "TOUPA'N amite amun za in hihpung taleh zong, kumpipa ka toupa, ka toupa mite mah hilou uh ahi maw? Bangziak a ka toupa'n huai theih kilawp ahia? Bangziak a Israelte siam louh tanlohna hi ding ahia oi?" achi hi.
Huchi in Joab apawtkhia a, Israel gam tengteng ah apai a, Jerusalem ah apai nawn hi.
Joab in mihing om zah David ahilh hi. Israel gam a namsau tawimi tengteng maktaduaikhat-le-nuaikhat ahi uh; huan Judah gam a namsau tawimi bel nuaili-le-singsagih ahi uh.
Levite leh Benjaminte bel asimtel kei; Joab in kumpipa thupiak zakdah lamtak ahi ngal a.
Huai thil ah Pathian akipak kei a; huchi in Israelte agawtta hi.
Huchi in David in Pathian kiang ah, "Hiai thil ka na hihna ah nakpitak in ka na hihkhialta ahi; himahleh na sikha thulimlouhna hehpih in ngaidam in, haihuaitak in ka na hihta hi,” achi hi.
Huan TOUPA'N zawlnei Gad kiang ah,
"Kuan inla, David kiang ah TOUPA'N hichi in achi: 'Thil thum ka hon tah: na tung a ka hih ding in alak ua khat tel in achi,' " va chi in.
Huchi in David kiang ah Gad ava hoh a, akiang ah, "TOUPA'N hichi in achi:

Akoi ahia na deih tel in; kum thum kialpi tun hia, na melmate namsau a delhphak a om a kha thum na melmate vuallelhsak hia, ni thum hipi len ding, TOUPA namsau a TOUPA angel in Israel gam tengteng a mi ahihmanthat zel?' chi in. Huchi in kei hon sawlpa bang ka chi dawn dia, kingaihtuah inla, hon hilh in," achi hi.
David in Gad kiang ah, "Ka lungzing mahmah, TOUPA khut ah puklut peuhmah mai leng; azahngaihna lah athupi mahmah ngal a; mihing khut ah zaw hon puklutsak mahmah ke'n," achi hi.
Huchi in TOUPA'N Israelte lak ah hipi alengsakta.

Huan Jerusalem khua hihse ding in Pathian in angel asawl a; ahihsiat dek laitak in, TOUPA'N a-en a, thil hoih lou hih atup akhiam a, mite hihmangthang angel kiang ah, "Ahunta; na khut lik nawn ke'n," achi hi. Huchi in TOUPA angel Jebus mi Ornan phual chin ah adingh hi.
David adaktou a, TOUPA angel, namsau phawisa a Jerusalem lam ngim a, lei leh van kikal a dingh amu hi. Huchi in David leh a-upate'n sai-ip puan silh in lei ah abokkhup uhi.

David in Pathian kiang ah, "Keimah ka hi kei a hia mipite sim ding chih thu pepa? Keimah ka hi ginat huai loutak a thil na hihkhial, hiai belamte'n bang thil ahia ahih tei uh? Aw TOUPA ka Pathian, keimah leh ka inkote tung ah na khutkha inla, na mite'n hipi thuak nawn kei uhen," achi hi.
Huchi in TOUPA angel in David kiang a Gad va hohtou a, Jebus mi Ornan phual a TOUPA dia maitam doh ding a David hilh ding in thu apia hi.
Gad in TOUPA min a athugen ziak in David ahohtouta hi.
Ornan akilehhei a, angel amu a; atapa li akiang a omte abuta uhi. Ornan in buh ana chil ahi.
David, Ornan kiang atun in, Ornan akihei a, David amuta a, huan phual a kipan apawtkhia a, amai a lei si in David ma ah abokkhup hi.
Huchi in David in Ornan kiang ah, "Hiai phual TOUPA a dia maitam ka bawlna ding in hon pe dih ve; aman kim geih la in hon pia in, mipite lak a hii akikhin theihna ding in," achi hi.

Ornan in David kiang ah, "Tang in, TOUPA ka kumpipa'n pha asak bang in hih hen; halmang a lat ding in bawngtalte, sing ding in phual vanzatte, tangbuang thillat ding in buhte ka hon pia hi; ka hon sutuah vek ding," achi hi.
Huan kumpipa David in Ornan kiang ah, "Hilou e; aman kim geih in ka lei zaw ding, man bei in TOUPA a ding in nang a ka la kei ding, halmang thillat leng ka lan kei ding,” achi a.
Huchi in David in huai mun leina in Ornan dangka-eng shekel zaguk apia hi.
David in huai ah TOUPA a ding in maitam abawl a, halmang thillatte leh lemna thillatte alan a, TOUPA asam a; TOUPA'N maitam tung ah mei in van a kipan in adawngta hi.
Huan TOUPA'N angel thu apia a, anamsau apai ah athun nawnta hi.
Huchi in David in Jebus mi Ornan phual ah TOUPA'N ahon dawng chih atheih in huai ah akithoihta hi.
Huai lai in Mosi in gamdai a TOUPA biakbuk leh halmang thillatna maitam abawl Gibeon khua mun sang ah a-om ahi.
Himahleh David bel TOUPA angel namsau akihtak ziak in Pathian dong ding in huai ah ahoh thei kei hi.
